releaseTitle: ATalk v3.4.5 — 120Hz Dynamic UI Upgrades: Dynamic Island, Elastic Swipe-to-Reply, Adaptive Bubble Morphing & Kinetic Lightbox
releaseNotes:
• Dynamic Island Call Capsule & Expanded Controls: Live audio waveform visualizer and call timer pill in header that fluidly expands into frosted Mute, Speakerphone, and End Call actions.
• Elastic Swipe-to-Reply: Telegram-style inward drag with rotating cyan curved arrow and spring damping release to quote messages.
• Adaptive Bubble Morphing: Telegram-style corner radius morphing (16dp to 4dp) and tight 4dp grouping for consecutive messages from the same sender.
• Kinetic Lightbox Viewer: Fullscreen OLED black photo viewer with pinch-to-zoom (up to 4x), double-tap zoom toggle (2.2x), and swipe-down-to-dismiss with real-time backdrop opacity fading.
• Ambient Cyber Glaze: Soft cyberpunk bloom under media cards on OLED black.
